summary: Fiserv Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a public offering of €500 million aggregate principal amount of 3.750% Senior Notes due 2030 and €500 million of 4.250% Senior Notes due 2034. The notes were issued under an existing indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee, supplemented by a Thirty-Ninth and Fortieth Supplemental Indenture. Proceeds use is not specified; the offering expands the company's debt capital structure. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No special-situation trigger exists; watch for use of proceeds in capital allocation.
